package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_scopes_defined_inline_repeatedly: Repeated ad hoc scope functions instead of shared named scopes.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule066PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
	Active   bool
}

func scenario066Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]Rule066PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule066PositiveRecord
	activeScope := func(db *gorm.DB) *gorm.DB {
		return db.Where("active = ?", true)
	}
	if err := db.Scopes(activeScope, func(db *gorm.DB) *gorm.DB {
		return db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Order("name ASC")
	}).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
